note: Each `lines` floor is the MEASURED percentage of the whole-corpus run that introduced the gate, rounded down; `measured` records that reading so the next reader can see how far the floor has drifted. `modules` and `populationLines` are floors of their own: measured 2026-10-31, removing components/management-panels.tsx (87.1% covered) RAISED the rendered percentage from 88.17% to 88.31%, so a percentage-only floor stays green while the largest panel disappears. A group whose population shrank is a breach even when its number went up.
